THE RESULT

# firms using connected APIs grow 12.7% faster( [Forbes](https://www.forbes.com/sites/googlecloud/2022/01/19/research-shows-api-management-fuels-growth-heres-why/)).

## where everything connects.

billing & accounting

A paralegal logs 5 hours, and the entry syncs to your accounting system automatically. No duplicate entry or end-of-month cleanup.

calendar & communication

Add a court date and it syncs to every attorney’s calendar, sends a client-portal invite, and creates a prep task instantly.

ai-powered case review

Upload medical records and they route to AI analysis automatically; summaries and timelines return to the case linked to the originals.

phone & client intake

A prospective client calls your office. Your phone system captures their information and creates a lead in Neostella.

court e-filing

A finalized motion sends automatically to your state’s e-filing portal with case data and filing codes pre-populated.
